user.title: Important: not a medical device
user.description:
Blood Glucose Monitor adds **extra** hints and information to Home Assistant, based on the glucose data of another integration (for example Nightscout).

**It is not a medical device and does not replace the alarms of your CGM, insulin pump or medical app** (for example Dexcom, LibreLink, CamAPS FX or xDrip+). Keep those alarms switched on at all times.

Notifications from Home Assistant can be delayed or not arrive at all, for example when Home Assistant, your network or the glucose data source is down. Never rely on them alone.

sources.title: Additional glucose data for {name}
sources.description:
Select the sensors of the glucose integration that provide the trend, the change to the previous reading and the time of the reading. Matching sensors of the same device are suggested automatically.

If a field is left empty, the attributes of the glucose sensor are used instead (`direction`, `delta` and `date`, as provided by Nightscout).

Without a reading time (sensor or `date` attribute), the age of the data is unknown and no alarms are possible.

data_description.trend_entity: Sensor with the glucose trend, for example "Glucose trend".
data_description.change_entity: Sensor with the change to the previous reading, for example "Glucose change".
data_description.reading_time_entity: Sensor with the time of the latest reading, for example "Glucose reading time".
data_description.glucose_unit: Only needed if the glucose or change sensor does not report a unit.

urgent_low.title: Urgent low alarm
urgent_low.description:
Alarm when the glucose stays below the threshold for the delay. It ends when the glucose reaches the threshold plus the clear offset (in {unit}). The pause does not apply to this alarm.

Notifications are automations with the trigger "Event received" on the event entity of this alarm: "started or repeated" and "acknowledged or over". The entity provides `title`, `message`, `tag`, `ack_action`, `glucose`, `unit`, `trend_arrow` and `phase` as attributes, among others.

data.only_when_home: Only when the person is at home

data_description.threshold: Threshold in {unit}. Leave the threshold and the threshold entity empty to switch the alarm off.
data_description.threshold_entity: Optional. Entity with the threshold, for example a threshold sensor of the glucose integration or an input number; takes precedence over the field.
data_description.clear_offset: The alarm ends at the threshold plus this value.
data_description.delay: How long the glucose has to stay below the threshold.
data_description.snooze: How long an acknowledged alarm stays silent. Afterwards it starts again if it still applies.
data_description.only_when_home: New alarms only start while the person is at home. A running alarm continues.

rapid_fall.title: Falling fast alarm
rapid_fall.description:
Alarm when the glucose falls fast: by the trend of the glucose data, or by the own rate of change between the last two readings. The rate limit is in {unit} per minute; an entity with the unit mg/dL/min or mmol/L/min takes precedence over the number.

Notifications are automations with the trigger "Event received" on the event entity of this alarm: "started or repeated" and "acknowledged or over". The entity provides `title`, `message`, `tag`, `ack_action`, `glucose`, `unit`, `trend_arrow` and `phase` as attributes, among others.

data_description.rate_limit: Change per minute, used with detection by rate.
data_description.rate_entity: Optional. Entity with the rate limit; takes precedence over the number.
data_description.delay: How long the fast change has to last.
data_description.snooze: How long an acknowledged alarm stays silent. Afterwards it starts again if it still applies.
data_description.only_when_home: New alarms only start while the person is at home. A running alarm continues.

data_loss.title: Data loss alarm
data_loss.description:

Notifications are automations with the trigger "Event received" on the event entity of this alarm: "started or repeated" and "acknowledged or over". The entity provides `title`, `message`, `tag`, `ack_action`, `glucose`, `unit`, `trend_arrow` and `phase` as attributes, among others.

charging.title: Charging reminder
charging.description:
Reminder from the reminder time until midnight while the phone is not charging and the battery is at or below the limit. It ends as soon as the phone charges. An entity for the time or the limit takes precedence over the field.

Notifications are automations with the trigger "Event received" on the event entity of this alarm: "started or repeated" and "acknowledged or over". The entity provides `title`, `message`, `tag`, `ack_action`, `glucose`, `unit`, `trend_arrow` and `phase` as attributes, among others.

data.only_when_home: Only when the person is at home

data_description.battery_entity: Sensor with the battery level of the phone in percent. Leave both sensors empty to switch the reminder off.
data_description.charging_entity: Sensor or binary sensor that tells whether the phone charges.
data_description.time_entity: Optional. Entity with the reminder time, for example an input datetime; takes precedence over the field.
data_description.battery_limit_entity: Optional. Entity with the limit in percent; takes precedence over the field.
data_description.snooze: How long an acknowledged alarm stays silent. Afterwards it starts again if it still applies.
data_description.only_when_home: New alarms only start while the person is at home. A running alarm continues.

cannula_change.title: Cannula change
cannula_change.description:
Reminder when the cannula (infusion set, also called site change; with a patch pump the pod) is due: at the last change plus the wear duration, or at a fixed time on that day. The last change comes from an entity, for example of the glucose integration; without one it is recorded with the button "Cannula changed" or the action "Record change". The reminder ends with the next change. An entity for the wear duration or the time takes precedence over the field.

Notifications are automations with the trigger "Event received" on the event entity of this reminder: "started or repeated", "acknowledged or over" and, with a warning, "due soon". The entity provides `title`, `message`, `tag`, `ack_action`, `due`, `last_change` and `phase` as attributes, among others.

data.only_when_home: Only when the person is at home

data_description.wear_duration: How long the cannula is worn. Leave empty to switch the reminder off.
data_description.wear_duration_entity: Optional. Entity with the wear duration in d, h or min; takes precedence over the field.
data_description.last_change_entity: Optional. Entity with the time of the last change. Without it, changes are recorded with the button or the action.
data_description.due_time: Optional. Remind at this time on the due day instead of exactly at the end of the wear duration.
data_description.time_entity: Optional. Entity with the fixed time, for example an input datetime; takes precedence over the field.
data_description.warning: Optional. Fires the event "due soon" this long before the reminder.
data_description.snooze: How long an acknowledged reminder stays silent. Afterwards it starts again if the change is still due.
data_description.only_when_home: New reminders and warnings only start while the person is at home. A running reminder continues.

report.title: Reports
report.description: One report per period in which the selected entity is on, for example per block of a schedule. When a period ends, the event entity "Report" of this person fires with the statistics, the start and the end of the period, and the sensor "Last report" is updated. The statistics come from the history (recorder).

data.only_when_home: Only when the person is at home

data_description.report_entity: Schedule, input boolean or binary sensor. Leave empty to switch the reports off.
data_description.cooldown: An alarm that starts again within this time after it was over counts as the same alarm (and the same low) in the report. 0 counts every new start.
data_description.only_when_home: The event "Report" only fires while the person is at home. The report and the sensor "Last report" are updated anyway.

estimate.title: GMI and estimated HbA1c
estimate.description: The sensors "GMI" and "Estimated HbA1c" are calculated from the mean glucose of the period, taken from the long-term statistics of the glucose sensor (recorder; only for sensors with a state class). With less than 70 % of the period covered by data, both are unknown. They are estimates, not a laboratory HbA1c.

data_description.period: Number of days, usually 90. Leave both fields empty to switch the sensors off.
data_description.period_entity: Number in days (or with a time unit such as h); takes precedence over the field.

pause.title: Pause
pause.description: The pause silences all alarms except urgent low. The urgent low alarm is never paused. The pause switch pauses for the pause duration; when it ends, the alarms are checked again at once. In addition, the alarms are paused while one of the pause entities is on, for example during the blocks of a schedule (nursery, school).

data_description.duration: How long the pause switch pauses the alarms.
data_description.pause_entities: Schedules, input booleans or binary sensors. While one of them is on, the alarms are paused; running alarms are acknowledged. When all are off again, an alarm starts again with its delay if the glucose is still in its range. Leave empty for no pause entity.

no_reading_time.title: No reading time for {name}
no_reading_time.description:
The glucose data of {name} has no reading time. Without it the age of the data is unknown and no alarms are possible.

Select a reading time sensor under **Configure → Glucose data**.

no_statistics.title: No long-term statistics for {name}
no_statistics.description:
The glucose sensor {entity_id} of {name} has no long-term statistics, so GMI and estimated HbA1c cannot be calculated. The recorder keeps them only for sensors with a state class (e.g. `measurement`) that are not excluded from the recorder.

If the source integration does not set a state class, add one with a customization (`state_class: measurement`), or switch the sensors off under **Configure → GMI and estimated HbA1c**.

acknowledge.description: Acknowledges one or all alarms of a person. Alarms of other entries are not affected.

alarm.description: Leave empty to acknowledge all alarms of the person.

record_change.name: Record change
record_change.description: Records a change of the cannula, the sensor or the reservoir of a person, now or at the given time. Not possible when the last change comes from an entity.
